p: Shaanxi Museum of Natural History (陕西自然博物馆)
Nature Exhibition Hall (陕西自然博物馆)
88 Chang'an South Road, Yanta District (雁塔区长安南路88号)
09:00-17:00, no tickets sold after 16:00, no entry after 16:30
The museum has exhibitions on nature, science and technology. There is also an exhibition hall devoted to the coal industry, as well as a dome cinema and a 5D cinema.
